doc.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Steve Allen's surviving tapes and writing
summary: Gibbs keeps tapes Allen gave him and praises him as a writer.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Great. Is that stuff still on tape you think? Is it gettable? Can you watch those things now?

I have some at home that Steve gave me of some of the shows that he’s done. And they’re priceless. One time he wrote an eleven minute bit, a hip version of “The Taming of the Shrew” with hip words, with every word ending with th. [speaks in lisp]. It was so dumb. You fell on the floor, you just couldn’t go through it. And he was a great writer, you know that?
Hold on for one second. We’re wired here.
